title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.44
exact_target: Does the coefficient at $x=1$ maximize the modulus of the relevant odd coefficients, first for the original $\alpha$ range and then for arbitrary positive $\alpha$ and $\beta$? The separately posed cubic-coefficient inequality uses a signed right-hand side and fails for some positive parameters.
